name: ccpopout
description: Read a Claude Code session one message at a time: what Claude did since each of your messages, in a pane or a side terminal

side.title: Side pane side
side.description: Where /popout side and /popout-side open the side pane, beside Claude Code. The CCPOPOUT_SIDE environment variable, when set to left or right, overrides it.

clean.title: Open in the clean view
clean.description: Whether the panes open in the clean view (tool calls hidden) until a view is chosen with z. From then on they open in the view last chosen, in every session.
